import sys

def most_repeated_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_count = 0
    best_substring = ""
    
    for length in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        for start in range(n - length + 1):
            substring = s[start:start + length]
            count = s.count(substring)
            if (count > max_count) or (count == max_count and length > len(best_substring)) or (count == max_count and length == len(best_substring) and substring > best_substring):
                max_count = count
                best_substring = substring
    
    return best_substring if best_substring else s

input_string = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(most_repeated_substring(input_string))
